faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About
faq.description: Everything you need to know about shared expense tracking, bill splitting, group payments, and managing expenses with {appName}.

whatIs.question: What is {appName}?
whatIs.answer: {appName} is a free group expense tracker that helps friends, roommates, and travel groups split bills, track balances, and settle up faster.

currencies.question: Does {appName} support different currencies?
currencies.answer: Yes. You can set a group currency when creating or editing a group, which makes {appName} useful for international trips and shared payments across currencies.

account.question: Do I need to create an account to use {appName}?
account.answer: No. You can create a group and start tracking shared expenses instantly. Share a group link so others can join without everyone needing to sign up.

attachments.question: Can I upload receipts or attachments?
attachments.answer: Yes. You can attach receipts, invoices, and payment screenshots to keep every expense organized and easy to verify.

splitMethods.question: How can I split expenses in {appName}?
splitMethods.answer: You can split bills equally, by percentage, or with custom amounts depending on how your group wants to share each expense.

multiplePayers.question: Can multiple people pay for the same expense?
multiplePayers.answer: Yes. {appName} supports multiple payers for a single expense, which is helpful for shared bookings, travel costs, and group payments.

travel.question: Can I track travel expenses with {appName}?
travel.answer: Yes. {appName} works well for trips and travel groups, including transport, hotels, food, and other shared travel costs.

export.question: Can I export expense reports?
export.answer: Yes. You can download expense reports and balance summaries for records, reimbursements, or planning.

mobile.question: Is {appName} mobile friendly?
mobile.answer: Yes. {appName} is optimized for phones and tablets, so you can add expenses and check balances on the go.

whoCanUse.question: Who can use {appName}?
whoCanUse.answer: {appName} works well for roommates, couples, travel groups, friends, teams, events, and anyone managing shared expenses together.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information {appName} uses to run shared expense groups, how that data is stored, and what choices you have. We aim to collect only the information needed to help groups track expenses, balances, and settlements.
privacy.section1Intro: {appName} collects the information required to create and manage shared expense groups:
privacy.section1Item1: Group names, member names, and currency preferences
privacy.section1Item2: Expense entries such as descriptions, amounts, payers, and participants
privacy.section1Item3: Technical and analytics data that helps us improve performance and usability
privacy.section2Body: Group and expense data may be stored locally on your device and on secure third-party infrastructure so shared group links work across devices and sessions. We use reasonable technical safeguards to protect data in transit and at rest, but no internet-based system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
privacy.section3Intro: We may use third-party services that support the product, such as:
privacy.section3Item3: Email and support tooling when you contact us
privacy.section3Outro: These providers may process limited technical or usage data on our behalf as described in their own privacy policies.
privacy.section4Body: {appName} may use cookies or similar technologies for analytics, session continuity, and product functionality. You can manage many of these preferences through your browser settings.
privacy.section5Intro: Depending on your location, you may have the right to:
privacy.section5Item1: Request access to the data associated with your use of the service
privacy.section5Item2: Delete expense data that you control
privacy.section5Item3: Limit analytics through browser controls or privacy tools
privacy.section6Body: We may update this Privacy Policy when the product, legal requirements, or data practices change. Continued use of the service after an update means the revised policy applies.
privacy.section7Body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to request help related to your data, please contact us through the Contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of {appName}. The product helps groups record shared expenses, calculate balances, and simplify settlements, but users remain responsible for reviewing entries and resolving payment disputes.
terms.section1Body: By accessing or using {appName}, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, you should stop using the service.
terms.section2Body: {appName} is a web-based expense tracker that allows groups to create shared expense records, assign payers and participants, and review balances. The service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis.
terms.section3Item1: The accuracy of expense data you enter
terms.section3Item3: Using the service in compliance with applicable laws
terms.section3Item4: Not using the service for illegal, harmful, or unauthorized purposes
terms.section4Intro: {appName} is a calculation and record-keeping tool. We are not responsible for:
terms.section4Item2: Inaccurate calculations due to user input errors
terms.section4Item3: Loss of data due to technical issues
terms.section4Item4: Any financial decisions made based on our calculations
terms.section5Body: The {appName} name, logo, design elements, and related content are owned by {appName} or its licensors. You may not reuse our branding without permission.
terms.section6Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the service after an update means you accept the revised terms.
terms.section7Body: We may suspend or terminate access if we believe a user has violated these terms or used the service in a way that harms the platform or other users.
terms.section8Body: For questions about these terms, please contact us through the Contact page.
